request:
SYNTHETIC PLANWORK RECOVERY FIXTURE. Plan a compare-and-swap dashboard import for the fictional Aster Charts application across both supplied repositories. Include a finite-state verification oracle for the shared iOS and macOS import coordinator, its idempotency store and storage transaction. Source facts come only from the two pinned READMEs. The following numbers and sequences are synthetic acceptance data, not claims about existing code.

Each row starts independently at revision R4, with canonical UID alpha absent, activity count 0, and no receipts, unless explicitly stated. A successful compare-and-swap increments the revision, writes the dashboard and appends one activity in a single transaction with its request receipt. A replay of a matching committed request ID returns its original outcome before rechecking the revision; a mismatched fingerprint gives conflict and never mutates. A stale preview gives a typed conflict before any write; a rolled-back transaction leaves no receipt, allowing the same request to retry. A preview is read-only.

V01: A previews Alpha at R4; B previews trimmed ' ALPHA '; B confirms B1 against R4; A confirms A1 against R4; inspect catalog alpha and the displayed conflict.
V02: A confirms A1 against R4; the response is lost; B previews and confirms B1 against R5; A resends A1 and subsequently resends A1 with a changed panel fingerprint.
V03: A starts with a validated draft at R4; the write of its receipt fails after the proposed dashboard insert; B reads; A retries the same request after storage recovery.
V04: A confirms with two unresolved datasource names and two valid panels. B loads the installed dashboard against a different catalog, then previews and cancels another definition for the same UID.
V05: B commits at R4. A gets R4 stale by confirming the old preview; A refreshes and reconfirms under a new request ID; B retries its original delivery after the two successes.
V06: C presents one unset title, a malformed panel expression and a future schemaVersion; first fix title, then fix the remaining validation errors, preview and close the screen without confirming.
V07: A and B each retry the same lost-response request simultaneously while C confirms a different draft under a different ID with a stale revision. Begin by successfully committing the repeated request so the loss is reproducible.
V08: Both shells start from independent storage with matching synthetic revision R4; repeat a preview, confirm, both retry modes and rollback independently, then compare canonical dashboard serialization and error presentation.

Use eight distinct verification entries with the corresponding V01 to V08 IDs. State ordered actions, returned UI/error state, the exact expected revision and activity count after any accepted writes, and durable receipt or catalog invariants. Each verification entry should be a compact 300 to 430 characters, including a machine-testable oracle. Provide six short implementation changes covering canonical normalization, read-only previews, compare-and-swap and receipt sequencing, shared coordinator errors, rollback and telemetry, and staged rollout. Brief goal and gaps. Cite the exact IDs box/charts:README.md and box/native-apple:README.md. Set issueTemplate and issueBody to null. Keep the entire structured output comfortably below the configured token ceiling.
